text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 7: XGBoost skill against the climatology stays within 0.04 of zero at every lead, and the rank rule is 0.04 to 0.09 below it'
text.tspan: Figure 7: XGBoost skill against the climatology stays within 0.04 of
zero at every lead, and the rank rule is 0.04 to 0.09 below it

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Skill: one minus the ratio of mean CRPS values; zero means the same as the 56-day trailing climatology. Band: 95% interval from resampling whole months. 35 batteries pooled; leads are 6-hour bins from the issue time. XGBoost skill is statistically significantly above zero in 1 of 12 bins (the bin from 12 to 18 hours, +0.013), which is exploratory.'
text.tspan: Skill: one minus the ratio of mean CRPS values; zero means the same as the 56-day trailing climatology. Band: 95%
35 batteries pooled; leads are 6-hour bins from the issue time. XGBoost skill is statistically significantly above
zero in 1 of 12 bins (the bin from 12 to 18 hours, +0.013), which is exploratory.
